I need a ctypes wrapper for `utab` in the test (not necessarily in accel.py). Let me add it to the test script directly.

cat > /app/tmp/t_utab.py << 'EOF'
import sys, random, ctypes, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_accel

os.environ.pop('SCAMP_NO_ACCEL', None)
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/app/tmp/helper.so')
lib.utab.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),
                     ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64)]
lib.utab.restype = ctypes.c_int

def c_utab(fib, ms):
    n = len(fib)
    addrs = (ctypes.c_uint64*(2*max(n,1)))()
    lens = (ctypes.c_int32*max(n,1))()
    for i,(a,l,h) in enumerate(fib):
        addrs[2*i] = a >> 64; addrs[2*i+1] = a & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; lens[i] = l
    out = (ctypes.c_int64*(129*129))()
    rc = lib.utab(addrs, lens, n, ms, out)
    assert rc == 0, rc
    return [[out[b*129+e] for e in range(129)] for b in range(129)]

rng = random.Random(7)
for t in range(40):
    n = rng.randint(0, 20)
    fib = gen_fib(rng, n, rng.choice(['mixed','short','long','aligned']))
    ms = rng.randint(1,32)
    fs = sorted(fib, key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))
    Uc = c_utab(fib, ms)
    Up = sp.py_utab(fs, ms)
    assert Uc == Up, ('C vs py U mismatch', t, fib, ms)
    # compare a sample against the naive transcription
    for b in range(0,128,7):
        for e in range(b+1, min(b+ms,128)+1, 5):
            assert Up[b][e] == naive_U(fib,b,e), ('naive mismatch', b, e, fib)
    print('case', t, 'n', n, 'ms', ms, 'OK')
print('UTAB ALL OK')
EOF
